idea-plugin.name: Linux.do Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Linux.do Explorer - Browse Linux.do Forum in IntelliJ IDEA

Linux.do Explorer is a powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin that allows you to browse the Linux.do forum content while coding.

Features

  • Immersive Experience: Seamlessly integrated with the IDE's native interface
  • Category Browsing: Browse various forum categories and topics
  • Topic Expansion: Expand topics directly in the sidebar to view all replies
  • One-click Refresh: Get the latest content in real-time
  • Quick Access: Open topics in the browser with one click
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.1.0

  • Preview Mode Selection: Switch between bottom panel preview and hover tooltip preview in settings
  • Image Filter Modes: Added normal/grayscale/halftone(dot matrix) filter options for images
  • Halftone filter creates a retro dot-matrix effect on images
  • Image hover delay: 0.5s delay before restoring color in grayscale/halftone modes
  • Improved UI: Removed unwanted borders from plugin window
  • Various UI polish and bug fixes

v1.0.2

  • Added "Load More" button for topics and replies pagination
  • Added search bar in toolbar to search topics
  • Added notification display settings (off/unread only/all)
  • Added auto-refresh on settings change
  • Topics and replies loading limit now configurable (5-30 for topics, 5-20 for replies)
  • Single-click to load more content
  • Fixed deprecated URL constructor warning

v1.0.1

  • Expanded supported IDE versions (2023.2 - 2025.3)
  • Added plugin icon

v1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Browse forum categories and topics
  • Topic preview support
  • Notification display
